WHEREAS, pursuant to the Violence Against Women Act (VA WA) of 1994. the Office of
Violence Against Women, a component of the U.S. Department of Justice implements and
administers the Grants to Encourage Arrest Policies and Enforcement of Protection Orders
Program; and
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne [Police Department], in collaboration with its
non-profit, non-g over m mental victim service partner, Safehouse. will implement this project to
provide a specialized domestic violence patrol unit, Community Advocacy Response Initiative
(CARI) ; and
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne submitted an application to the U.S. Department of
Justice for a FY 2012 Grants to Encourage Arrest Policies and Enforcement of Protection Orders
Program; and
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne's application has been approved for project costs in the
amount of $300,000.00, through a competitive process and requires no match for acccptance and
use of said award; and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne supports acceptance of the
award of the Grants to Encourage Arrest Policies and Enforcement of Protection Orders Program;
and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne and the City of Cheyenne
[Police Department]. understand the long-term obligations of the Grants to Encourage Arrest
Policies and Enforcement of Protection Orders Program, and are commited to fulilling the
requirements of the grant immediately upon acceptance.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY
OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING, that the Governing Body approves and accepts the FY 2012
Grants to Encourage Arrest Policies and Enforcement of Protection Orders Program from the U.S.
Department of Justice, Office of Violence Against Women Grant in the amount of S300,000.00
(Award No. 2012-WE-AX-0058).
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED, that the Mayor and City Clerk are authorized to execute
all documents relating to the Grants to Encourage Arrest Policies and Enforcement of Protection
Orders Program.
PRESENTED, READ AND ADOPTED this
day of
